r_async_compute.reason: Async compute queue (PF-0027): where the sky / screen-space / froxel passes run, never what they compute (the same image); a performance and driver-debug switch.

r_atmosphere.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Atmosphere / aerial perspective: distant haze. sky_aerial_scale was archived and player-settable 0 .. 20.

r_auto_exposure.reason: Visibility: changes what you can see relative to other players. Exposure compensation (+-4 EV) and auto exposure on / off move the night darkness floor; the Off level had fixed exposure (V10).

r_bloom.reason: Bloom on / off follows the level; its strength is the Look's (r_bloom_intensity, locked).

r_bloom_intensity.reason: Look-owned: tonemapper and bloom / flare / dirt / distortion strength belong to the Look; a glare or distortion slider changes what you see near lights and the sun.

r_brightness.reason: Brightness: display calibration, narrowed to 0.85 .. 1.15 (was 0.3 .. 3.0, which lifted the night darkness floor).
